about: USD per million tokens. The plan multiplies these by turn_tokens, the mean tokens per turn of each client, measured on 2026-11-17 in an 18-turn smoke run with claude haiku and codex gpt-6-luna at low effort. Claude reports its own cost per turn, so a Claude run records the measured figure; a Codex run records tokens priced with these rates.

claude.source: Anthropic first-party API prices, as cached by the claude-api skill on 2026-11-03. cache_write is 1.25 x input for every model, and cache_read is 0.1 x input for Haiku; both are the standard ratios, not quoted prices.

codex.source: Third-party listings of OpenAI API prices (devtk.ai), November 2026; OpenAI's own page was not checked. Under a ChatGPT sign-in, Codex usage counts against the plan's limits, not dollars. Add a model here to price it.
